title: Opportunities and challenges – the impact of Chinese competition on Hungarian manufacturing
abstract: FLAG: Book chapter (Edward Elgar 2012). No publisher-side abstract for the chapter. Author Ágnes Csermely's companion conference talk slides covering the same material are public at https://www.oenb.at/dam/jcr:df255699-0314-41c3-bc43-e56fa2335c83/Csermely%20%E2%80%93%20Opportunities%20and%20Challanges%20Impact%20of%20Chineese%20competition%20on%20Hungarian%20Manufacturing.pdf — they outline three findings: (i) Hungarian plant-level effects of Chinese import competition (no significant impact on survival, employment, output, or TFP; wages respond negatively); (ii) GVAR simulations showing growing indirect China→eurozone→Hungary trade-channel effects 2000–2008; (iii) commodity-price/inflation channel. Editor: decide whether to draft from the slides or seek the chapter PDF.
